expectations.note: After clearing the relevant preference and restarting, the fresh Dot showed only the pulsing dot with no artist/title overlay.
Show song info was enabled and the restarted Dot still rendered the overlay, confirming persistence.
The option was turned off and restarted; the resulting Dot showed no overlay, confirming the round trip.
At 100% with genuinely long artist and title metadata, the overlay visibly occupies the same region as the centered pulsing dot.
At 150% with the same long metadata, the enlarged overlay still intersects the centered pulsing dot.
The candidate's normal PNG is a synthetic drawing with placeholder metadata, not a genuine 100% app capture of the required long case; my genuine 100% capture also shows overlap.
The candidate's maximum PNG is a synthetic drawing with placeholder metadata, not a genuine 150% app capture of the required long case; my genuine 150% capture shows overlap.
Normal and maximum tree/semantics captures show non-empty hero-artist and hero-song text, with sizes 30/15 and 45/22.5 respectively.
Ordinary undercover fixture metadata also renders under the pulsing dot at both captured scales, so the common case is not clean in this implementation.
Repeated toggles, restarts, scale changes, and long/short playback left the app responsive; the final runtime capture reports zero overflow/error reports.
